Experience unmatched versatility with the NHD-120-IW-TX, your ultimate AV over IP solution. This 2-gang in-wall encoder, part of our 100 series, boasts an HDMI input and a dedicated Ethernet port, designed to seamlessly integrate with today's modern laptops and tablets. Whether you're enhancing your educational setup or optimizing your corporate environment, this encoder is your key to success.

The NetworkHD™ 100 Series utilizes low bandwidth, infinitely scalable technology with the addition of powerful video wall support up to 16×16 for the best all-round solution for commercial AV installations. A 100 Series encoder can either be paired with a 100 Series decoder for matrix switching to individual screens or for video wall decoding, with both decoders including HDMI and analog audio breakout outputs, or an NHD-150-RX decoder for multiview monitoring.

Choose your flavor, the NHD-120-IW-TX can encode AV signal using either H.264 or H.265. Using H.265 provides incredibly efficient video streams. For comparison, an H.265 5Mbps stream is equal to a 30Mbps H.264 stream.
The NHD-120-TX can encode AV signal using low bandwidth compression technology. Using this technology provides incredibly efficient video streams.

The NHD-120-TX is now supporting 4K content that ensures compatibility with the HDMI v1.4 HDCP 2.2 video source, while a built-in scaler ensures hassle-free mixing of the latest 4K displays and 1080p screens within an installation.
